metadata.title: Secure High-Performance Computing

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for operating high-performance computing platforms that preserve isolation, correct identity attribution, and data protection across shared research workloads.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: High-performance computing clusters, batch schedulers, shared accelerators, and associated storage and interconnect fabrics.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Composite pattern asserting that foundational HPC platform, identity, and data protection trust requirements are satisfied.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Secure HPC assumes baseline trust in shared HPC platforms and scheduler-mediated execution.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Secure HPC requires correct identity attribution and access control for users, jobs, and schedulers.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Secure HPC requires protection of data used and produced by high-performance computing workloads.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Privilege escalation risks arising from shared scheduler or compute context.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Lateral movement across jobs, users, or shared nodes in HPC environments.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Unauthorized collection of sensitive or proprietary research data from shared HPC storage.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Privilege escalation through exploitation of shared operating system or scheduler context.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Data collection via access to shared filesystem or scratch storage.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Execution isolation across shared compute nodes and workloads.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Privileged access management for HPC administrators and scheduler services.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Lifecycle management to reduce residual data exposure after workload completion.

metadata.remarks: Secure High-Performance Computing is a composite pattern asserting that platform trust, identity and access control, and data protection requirements for shared HPC environments are collectively satisfied. It introduces no independent controls and exists solely as an aggregate trust claim for use in solution patterns and system security and privacy plans.

components.title: High-Performance Computing Core
components.description: Baseline trust assumptions for shared HPC platforms and scheduler-mediated execution.

components.title: HPC Identity and Access
components.description: Correct identity attribution and access control for HPC users and workloads.

components.title: HPC Data Protection
components.description: Protection of data stored, processed, and produced by HPC workloads.
